tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs gso sbyong dang 'brel ba'i cho ga sgrib 'joms ye shes chu rgyun ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru ār+yā mo gha pā shā ya/ mtshan dang rnam 'gyur gzungs kyi byin rlabs stobs// nyin byed stong 'bar zer gyis reg tsam gyis// thog med sgrib pa'i mun khang rab brtol nas// ye shes snang ba rgyas mdzad de la 'dud// 'brel tshad don ldan rgyal ba dang*// rgyal ba'i sras kyis nan tan tu// gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho la// shas tsam spyod pa'ang skal ba bzang*// 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa dang mdo gzungs kyi dgongs pa 'phags bod mkhas grub rnams kyis phyag bzhes su mdzad pa smyung bar gnas pa'i cho ga nyams su len pa'i tshul la/ sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs kyi cho gas rgyas bkab cing*/ de ni rgyud sde'i tshul dang mthun par de nyid bcu drug gi sa bcad du bsdus pa la bsdu tshul 'dra min cung zad snang ba'i nang tshan skyid grong lo tsā ba'i lugs nyid rnam pa gsal bas de ltar na/ sngon 'gro gtsang khrus maṇ+ḍal spyi bshags dang*// gso sbyong bslab pa dngos nyid blang dang bzhi// bcas gshom sbyor ba bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang*// de bzhin mdun bskyed bzlas pa bcas te bzhi// thun mtshams phyag mchod bstod dang 'dod don gsol// gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa rnams te bzhi// nongs bshags gzungs sgrub khrus chu'i byin rlabs blang*// gshegs sdud bsngo ba bkra shis rjes bzhi'o// zhes so// de la nyams su len pa'i gang zag ni/ brgyud ldan gyi bla ma las 'di'i lung bzhi mnos shing bya rgyud spyi'i dam tshig gsum gzhir bzhag khyad par pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig bcu gsum dang ldan pas/ dus byang bgrod kyi yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la dngos gzhi khel bar byas te/

gnas khang yid dang mthun la gtsang sbra byi dor byas pa'i phugs logs su dkon mchog gi rten spyi dang bye brag don zhags lha lnga'i bris sku sogs yod na bkram pa'i mdun du 'og de nyid lnga pa'i skabs su bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs 'du bya'o// nyams su blang ba'i sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro'i thog mar gtsang khrus bgyid pa'i de nyid ni/ nangs snga bar langs la dang po thal mo sbub por sbyar ba la gung mo gnyis rtse mor byas shing sor mo gzhan rnams kyang rtse mo cung zad ma reg pa pad+ma kha 'bus pa'i rnam pa pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya de snying gar bzhag nas/ oṃ pad+mo d+bhab ye swā hā/ zhes brjod pas pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gzung*/ de nas pad+ma satwa dang*/ oṃ ha ya grī wa hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa'i chus yan lag lnga khrus dag par bya/ gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal gyi de nyid ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mas bskor ba mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par gyur par dmigs la/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma'am bdun ma gang lcogs lan gsum 'bul dgos pa'i dang po'i tshig mjug ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo bla ma dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs tha mi dad pa la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes sogs dang*/ gnyis pa'i mjug tu/ chos dkon mchog gi ngo bo gzungs kyi sngags rnams la/ zhes dang*/ gsum pa'i mjug dge 'dun dkon mchog gi ngo bo 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la/ zhes bsgyur/ de nas/ sa gzhi spos byugs sngags bcas brjod do// gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa'i de nyid ni/ pus btsugs thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/

bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug gi dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la ma gus pa dang*/ pha dang ma la ma gus pa dang*/ mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma gus pa dang*/ grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la ma gus pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang*/ gsung rab kyi glud zos pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur ba btab pa la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyes ltung gi tshogs ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du bstsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rangs pa de dag thams cad/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so// slan chad kyang bsdam par bgyi lags so// zhes lan gsum mthar/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas 'phags pa la thim/ de nyid spyi bo'i gtsug nas mar byon bdag dang gnyis su med par gyur/ bzhi pa gso sbyong len pa'i de nyid ni/ thog mar sdom rgyun bar ma chad pa'i slob dpon gyi mdun du phyag gsum 'tshal/ thal mo sbyar nas 'dug pa la/ slob dpon gyis 'chad par nus na chos bshad skabs dang bstun pas mtshams sbyar/ mdor bsdu na/ 'o skol rnams sku tshe sngon ma la bsod rnams kyi tshogs gtso bor gyur pa'i dge ba rgya chen po bsags pa la brten nas tshe 'dir yang dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnam par dag pa thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir spyir lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi dge ba spang zhing*/

sgo gsum gyi dge ba la 'bad par bya dgos/ de 'dra nam 'chi cha med pas da lta nyid du 'bad par bya'o// shi nas ngan song gsum du skyes na sdug bsngal myong 'gyur la bsams te/ chos spyod rnam par dag pa 'di lta bu la pha mas thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du 'jug par bya snyam du byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal thob la/ bslab pa'i gzhi gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa blang ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po dang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de dag gis/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang*/ phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong nges par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi pas kyang sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang*/ phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/

dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du gso sbyong nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum dang*/ deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing*// gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya// 'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing*// rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o// skyon ni mang po nyer bsten pa'i// chang ni yongs su spang bar bya// khri stan chen po mi bya zhing*// de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas// dri dang phreng ba dang ni rgyan// gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya// ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni// srog bcod la sogs mi byed pa// de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spang*// bla med byang chub myur thob shog /sdug bsngal mang 'khrugs sems can rnams// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ces kyang lan gsum brjod nas/ tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs bzla ba ni/ oṃ a mo gha shī la/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ mahā shud+dha satwa/ pad+ma bi bhū ṣi ta bhu dza/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ hrīḥtrai lo kya bi dza ya a mo gha pā sha a pra ti ha ta hrīḥhaḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig re bzlas shing*/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po= shes rab kyi phung po= rnam par grol ba'i phung po= rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*// zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang*/ rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur sogs sh+lo ka gcig kyang brjod do// rjes su rten gyi drung du blang ba'i skabs gong gi maṇ+ḍal dang sdig bshags grub nas tshogs zhing ma bsdus pa'i mdun du len/ slob dpon dgongs gsol mi brjod/ gso sbyong blangs rjes tshogs zhing rang la bsdu'o// lnga pa bcas gshom gyi de nyid ni/

stegs du khebs gtsang mas bkab pa'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal ba byung lnga dang dri bzang gis byugs pa la rdul tshon gyis dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad lte ba dkar po la zla gdan steng tshom bu dkar po/ 'dab bzhi shar dmar po'i steng zla gdan la tshom bu dmar po/ lhor dmar po'i steng nyi gdan la tshom bu dmar po/ nub nag po'i steng nyi gdan la tshom bu nag po/ byang dkar po'i steng zla gdan la tshom bu dkar po dgod/ mtshams bzhi mdzes tshon bya/ de rgyab gru bzhir bcad pa'i shar khyams sogs phyogs mdog byas pa dgod/ de'i mdun nam g.yas g.yon gang bder me tog gi tshom bu'am pad+ma'i gdan la bum pa/ oṃ a mṛ to d+bha bod+bha bas bsang*/ dri bzang gi chus sum gnyis dgang*/ bya rgyud kyi bum rdzas bco lnga pa gzhug 'o ma can nam 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan/ ras kha tshar ma nyams bas mgul chings byas pa dgod/ chu gnyis nyer spyod 'dzoms na so so'i rdzas ldan dang*/ 'bul gtor dkar zlum dkar gsum mngar gsum las bcos pa rnams gtsang sgra dang ldan par bkod/ a ga ru'i bdug spos dang*/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ khrus chab/ ting shags sogs nyer mkho rnams tshogs par bya'o// drug pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs bsags kyi de nyid ni/ sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i snying rje'i sems drag tu bsgoms la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan bdun nam nyer gcig brjod pa'i mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod zhags pa'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ gnas yo byin rlabs ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis deng 'dir khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa lta bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pas mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang*// lag mthil ltar mnyam bai ḍūr+ya'i// rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig /phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing 'di dag tu lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya la sogs pa rnam par dag cing yid du 'ong ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ na ma s+sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa bh+yaḥ oṃ sarba bit+pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā bar+t+te bh+yaḥswā hā/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs brjod/ tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing gi dbus su rang nyid thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla nyi ma'i gdan so so'i steng du 'phags pa don yod zhags pa lha lnga la yi dam zhi khro sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ spos btul/ mos gus gdung shugs drag pos thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// phyogs dus kun khyab skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs 'tshal// oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ de nas thog mar gnas lnga sa la 'dud pa'i phyag 'tshal te/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku// mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes// bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan rdzogs// bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs// dgag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan// mu stegs ri dwags skrag mdzad pa'i// bla ma'i gsung la= /bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra// bde gsal mi rtog stong pa'i ngang*/ rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i// bla ma'i thugs la= /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// bla ma rnams la= /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs// gang gi sgrub thabs gso sbyong brgyud pa yi// bla ma rnams la gus pas= /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i gzhi// de bzhin gshegs la= /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las sgrol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i// zhi gyur chos la= /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab ba dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*// dge 'dun la yang= /mthun pa'i dge tshogs smon lam rmad byung zhing*// spyad pa spyod tshe na yang mchod gyur la// bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la phyag= /'gro ba nyon mongs dug gis gzir ba la// thugs rjes dug sel sman mchog bdud rtsi ni// smon lam chen po grub par gyur pa yi// bde gshegs 'khor dang bcas la= /mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal// gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la=

/rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis// mnyam med mkhyen chen khyed la= /'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la= /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal// gzi brjid 'od dpag med la= /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags// yon tan dam pa kun nas bsags// spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba'i// rtag par brtse la= /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba ma lus dang*// byang chub sems dpa' rgyal sras dpag med tshogs// rdul gcig steng du rdul snyed bzhugs pa yi// bla med 'phags pa'i tshogs la= /ye shes bla ma 'od kyi tog /de bzhin smon lam blo gros dang*// dbang po zhi dang 'jam dbyangs la// bdag gi gus pas= /'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun bzang sogs// byang sems chen po rnams la= /lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud cing*// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyal chen bzhi// gtsang ris mgon po 'khor dang bcas// mgon po lcam dral la sogs pa'i// chos skyong rnams la= /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa rnams dang*/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun// bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la// lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis// rgyal ba thams cad yid kyi mngon sum du// zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis// rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag

/de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa// thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos// de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// ces pa rnams kyis phyag bya/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byugs pa gdugs mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*// phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*// bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis// rgyal ba de dag la yang mchod par bgyi// mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// zhes pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa'i// rin chen me tog la sogs mchod pa'i tshogs// nam mkha' khyab par sems kyis mngon sprul nas// gzhal med khang du sprin bzhin gtibs gyur cig /ces dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin du sngags kyi mgo mjug gnyis po 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar la/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke/ badz+ra gan+dhe/ badz+ra nai wid+yā/ badz+ra shab+da zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma spyi ltar gyi mjug bla ma dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sogs kyi mthar/ sa gzhi spos byug gang gi mchod rdzas sogs tshigs su bcad pa rnams dang*/ deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gus pas khyed la dbul bar bgyi// kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa// yon gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis// bdag la brtse bar nyer dgongs te// bdag gi 'di dag bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ gu ru lo ke shwa ra bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/

zhes 'bul/ sdig pa bshags pa sogs yan lag lhag ma rnams ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rangs// gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron me dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul// mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rangs bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// de dag thams cad byang chub phyir bsngo'o// de nas tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig chags sdang med pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod de tshogs zhing rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam mo// bdun pa bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i de nyid ni/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba gur bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/

de'i nang du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes par byas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po'i steng du zla ba'i gdan/ shar du pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du zla ba'i gdan/ lhor pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du nyi ma'i gdan/ nub tu pam̐ las pad+ma nag po'i steng du nyi ma'i gdan/ byang du pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po'i steng du zla ba'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrīḥyig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' can/ mchod phyir thogs dkar po 'chang ba/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ shar du ha las don yod zhags pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na zhags pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na lcags kyu dang phreng ba 'dzin pa/ rgyan dmar po dang stod g.yogs bsnams pa/ lhor hūm̐ las khro bo rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'phyar ba/ dbu'i steng na rta mgo ljang gu dang*/ dbu skra smin ma dmar ser/ khro gnyer bsdus shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ sbrul rgyan dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ nub tu pha las lha mo ral gcig ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma/ g.yas bzhi na ral gri dang zhags pa pad+ma dang mda'/ g.yon bzhi na 'khor lo dang dbyug pa rtse gsum dang gzhu bsnams pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa dmar ser gcig tu 'khyil ba/ sbrul rgyan dang*/ glang po che'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/

stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ byang du ṭa las khro gnyer can sku mdog skya bo zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas gnyis na pad+ma dang dbyugs pa/ g.yon gnyis na spyi blugs dang phreng ba/ gzhon nu dar la babs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dkar gyi na bza' dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon pa'i bol gong la g.yas pa'i sor mo brten pa'i tshul gyis bzhengs stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrī yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas don yod zhags pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a mo gha pā sha sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pa sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñcha hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med/ don yod zhags pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ rta mgrin la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ral gcig ma la mi bskyod pa/ khro gnyer can la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du 'khod pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te hrīḥl thim/

na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te kā ru ṇā ya mūr+t+ta ya hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po'o// oṃ hrīḥtrai lo kya bi dza ya a mo gha pā sha a pra ti ha ta hrīḥhaḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes don zhags dang*/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ haṃ kha ta bhuñja satwā ya swā hā/ zhes rta mgrin dang*/ oṃ e ka dzā ṭi ma hā ra ṣa ṇa/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ sa ma sa ma pra sha ma na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ral gcig ma dang*/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ sarba bha ba paṇ+ḍar ṇī hūm̐ phaṭa pa tā ya swā hā/ zhes khro gnyer can gyi'o// gtso bo la sngags brgya rtsa song na 'khor la bcur bzlas te des rigs 'gres sbyar/ 'dir bzla bya'i gtso bo ni gzungs sngags nyid yin te de ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran pas gdon par gsungs te/ phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi rnam par 'phrul pa ste/ sems de ni sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral la ci yang ma grub par bsam pa ni chos sku'i sangs rgyas bdag med pa rjes su dran pa dang*/ gzugs sku'i sangs rgyas lha lnga po'i rnam pa gsal lam mer rjes su dran pa'i ngang nas/ don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i mdo'i dbu nas brtsams te/ don gyi phyir yang ngo*// bar lan gcig gzungs ring lan bdun nam gsum bklags pas las thams cad grub pa yin no// zhes sogs phyin chad tshar gcig brjod/ de nas pha rol phyin pa drug gi gzungs lan gsum re sogs brjod/ mthar bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ oṃ a mo gha pā sha sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs gong ltar gyis mchod/ thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// don yod zhags pa khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal// ral gcig ma dang lha mo khro gnyer can// 'phags pa lha lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/

bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'khor bcas rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /don zhags lha lnga 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dge ba bsngo/ brgyad pa mdun bskyed kyi cho ga gzungs bzlas bya ba'i de nyid ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs brjod/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar la/ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ sogs nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ snying po rnams cung zad re dang*/ gtso bor gzungs gong du bshad pa ltar bzla/ gtso bo'i phyag g.yas pa las babs pa'i bdud rtsis bum pa gang ba'i dmigs pa'ang bya'o// dgu pa mchod bstod bya ba'i de nyid ni/ de'ang yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas bsags sbyang bya ba ste/ bdag mdun dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang slob ma g.yog dang bcas shing mgron thabs kyi lha gsar du'ang 'dus par bsams te/ oṃ phyogs dus kun khyab nas mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// bar gong du bshad pa ltar phyag bya/ mchod pa kha gsos la bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo dang*/ gzhan yang 'phan gdugs bla bre rgyal mtshan ba dan la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu rgya nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam zhing dus zhing khams ji srid du gnas par gyur/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā nas shab+da swā hā'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas shing*/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes byin dbab/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// oṃ gu ru lo ka nā tha de wa ḍā ki nī traṃ rat+na sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin zhabs bsil la/ pā d+yaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra sogs dang*/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas sil snyan gyi bar/ puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu tra nas/ shab+da pū dza'i bar gyis dbul lo// de nas maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig dbul/ spro na/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// rin chen bla bre yid 'ong rgyan dang bcas// chen po'i nyer spyad bde ba sgrub pa yang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra bi tā na ā hūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// lha rdzas las byung sna tshogs mdog dang ldan// ba dan yid 'ong phyogs bcur g.yo ba yang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra pā tā kī āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra ts+tsha traṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// rin chen rgyal mtshan nor bu'i tog gis spras// bdud kyi dgra las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan phyar// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra dh+wa dza āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs mchod pa'i yo byad ji snyed pas mchod/ sdig pa bshags pa ni/

bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas// rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'i// bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin pa// gang yang rung ba bgyis ba rnams// mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du// thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis// yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// 'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig /nongs pa lags par gzung du gsol// 'di ni bzang po ma lags pas// slan chad bdag ni yod mi bgyid// rjes su yi rang ba ni/ sems can kun gyi ngan song gi /sdug bsngal ngal gsol bde ba dang*// sdug bsngal can dag bder gnas la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa// de la rjes su yi rang ngo*// lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// nges par thar la yi rang ngo*// chos 'khor bskul ba ni/ phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thums la// chos kyi sgron me sbar du gsol// mya ngan mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// 'gro 'di ldong bar mi 'god phyir// bskal pa grangs med bzhugs su gsol// bsngo ba ni/ de ltar 'di dag kun byas te// dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang*// des ni sems can thams cad kyi// sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog /ces yan lag bdun gyis mchod/ bstod pa dha byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa sogs kyis bstod do// bcu pa gsol ba gdab pa'i de nyid ni/ thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gis chos nyid kun tu myur du byang gyur cig /thugs rje= /bdag gis shes rab spyan ni myur du thob gyur cig /thugs rje= /bdag gis sems can thams cad myur du sgrol gyur cig /thugs rje= /bdag gis thabs la mkhas pa myur du thob gyur cig /thugs rje= /bdag ni shes rab gru ru myur du zhugs gyur cig

/thugs rje= /bdag ni sdug bsngal mtsho las myur du brgal gyur cig /thugs rje= /bdag gis tshul khrims lam la myur du rdzogs gyur cig /thugs rje= /bdag gis myang 'das ri la myur du 'dzegs gyur cig /thugs rje= /bdag gis 'dus ma byas gyi khang par myur du 'dus gyur cig /thugs rje= /bdag gis myur du chos nyid sku dang mthun gyur cig /gal te bdag gis mtshon gyi ri la phyogs gyur na// mtshon gyi ri ni rab tu zhig cing snyil gyur cig /gal te bdag gis chu tshan zangs la phyogs gyur na// me dang chu tshan rab tu zhi zhing med gyur cig /gal te bdag gis sems can dmyal bar phyogs gyur na// sems can zhe sdang zhi zhing sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig /gal te bdag gis yi dwags bkres skom phyogs gyur na// yi dwags ltogs pa rab tu 'grangs shing tshim gyur cig /gal te bdag gis lha ma yin du phyogs gyur na// lha ma yin gyi ngan sems yongs su zhi gyur cig /gal te bdag gis byol song rgyud du phyogs gyur na// bdag gis shes rab chen po'i rang bzhin thob gyur cig /ces pa dang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dgongs su gsol/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas bde bar gshegs ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag skyes bu dam pa rnams sku tshe ring zhing 'gro don 'phel bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ sems can thams cad bde zhing dam pa'i chos spyod par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'byongs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdor na tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa byang nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes gsol ba gdab bo// bcu gcig pa mchod gtor 'bul ba'i de nyid ni/ mchod gtor bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka a mo gha pā sha a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ de'i tshe lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs te bzhes pas mnyes par bsam/ sngar bzhin mchod pas mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// bcu gnyis pa smon lam gdab pa'i de nyid ni/ thog mar byin rlabs dang bcas pa'i mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig gtang rag gi tshul du phul/ de nas/ skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du// rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang*// snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus ldan// spyan ras gzigs kyi dam tshig la gnas shog /byang chub sems ni rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /ces smon lam gdab/ bcu gsum pa lhag chad kha skong ba'i de nyid ni/ thog mar me long du lha'i gzugs brnyan shar ba la bum chu blugs shing*/ 'gro ba'i sgron me spyan ras gzigs mgon la// dri zhim bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis khrus gsol pas// 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis dri ma kun bsal nas// dri bral sku gsum brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sku khrus gsol/ spro na ji ltar bltams pa sogs khrus chog rgyas pa dri phyis na bza' 'bul ba'i bar bya/

de nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag las dang po par gyur cing*/ sems bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ sngags ma dag pa dang*/ cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa dang*/ gtsang sbra chung ba la sogs pa thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed la bzod par gsol gyis/ bdag cag gi sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ pad+ma satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ pad+ma satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ pad+ma mā me muñca/ pad+mī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes ci nus sam lan bdun nam gsum brjod/ bcu bzhi pa khrus chu'i byin rlabs len pa'i de nyid ni/ gtso bo'i snying po lan gcig brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang gzugs 'phags pa gtso 'khor lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ de rnams kyi phyag g.yas pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi spyi bor babs lus phyi nang med par lan gsum du bkrus pas dang pos nyon sgrib dag gnyis pas shes sgrib dag gsum pas skye med chos sku thob par bsams la/ dung zhal gyi chu la gzungs bum gyi chu thigs bsres te/ gdong dang kha lan gsum du bkrus shing 'grub na gzungs ring bzla/ mi lcogs na snying po rnams bzla bzhin pas bum chu lan gsum 'thung*/ lha lnga po rnams rim par rang gi spyi bor thim pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur cing cung zad mnyam par bzhag pas ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur/ bco lnga pa bskyed rim 'jug ldang gi de nyid ni/

mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor tshom bu'i lha la dmigs te/ thugs rje'i phyag na pad+ma yis// yid kyi pad+mo kha phye nas// rin po che ltar gshegs nas kyang*// tshur byon thugs rje chen po mu// zhes brjod pas mdun bskyed rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas bya/ nyin phyi ma'i rjes chog gi skabs yin na me tog gam rdul tshon gyi tshom bu bsdus/ gzungs sgrub kyi bum chu smyung gnas sgrub pa'i phyag bzhes spyi ltar spyad par bya'o// rang nyid skad cig gis thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku sgyu ma ltar ldang zhing spyod lam kun lha sngags snying rje'i rnal 'byor dang mi 'bral bar bya'o// bcu drug pa dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo zhing bkra shis mtha' rgyas kyi de nyid ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ 'di ltar bdag gis gso sbyong gi tshul khrims la bslabs shing sgom bzlas bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas sems can thams cad kyi don du 'phags pa gzi brjid 'od dpag med pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /'jam dpal ji ltar mkhyen cing dpa' ba dang*// sogs bzang spyod gsham gyi smon lam yongs rdzogs dang*/ rgyas par spro na smon lam gzhan yang rgyas par gdab bo// de nas shis brjod ni me tog 'thor bzhin pas/ ston mchog dam pa sogs zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad kyis thog drangs/ rgyas bsdus skabs su bab par brjod pas grub bo// cho ga 'di dus khyad par can la sbyor dngos rjes tshang gis nyams su len na/

zla ba yar ngo'i tshes bdun la sbyor ba stan gcig brgyad la dngos gzhi smyung gnas/ dgu la rjes chog byas pas tshar gcig 'grub/ de ltar lan bdun byas pas phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpar 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan yang mdo dang rtog pa las gsungs pa'i phan yon tshad med pa rnams 'thob par 'gyur ro// de'ang brgya rtsa brgyad sogs myur du grub par 'dod na/ tshes brgyad dang*/ bcu bzhi dang*/ nyer gsum/ nyer dgu la dngos gzhi khel bar byas te de dag gi snga phyi nyin la sbyor ba dang rjes cho ga bya/ de tsam mi nus na gong du bshad pa'i tshes rnams la dngos gzhi smyung gnas kyi cho ga bya zhing gzungs bzlas kyang mdo'i dngos bstan yin pas chog go /sbyor dngos gnyis la cho ga tshar gsum/ rjes chog la tshar gcig gtong dgos pas cho ga phyi ma gnyis dang rjes chog skabs gso sbyong len mi dgos pa ma gtogs/ khrus nas bsngo ba'i bar bskyar nas bya bar gsungs/ sbyor ba'i nyin nyi ma phyed yan chad dkar gsum gyi bza' btung bya/ phyed man chad ja dang chu gtsang zhun mar ma gtogs bza' btung ci'ang mi bya/ mdo 'di nyid las 'byung ba sha chang sgog btsong 'byung po'i lhag ma rnams dang*/ bya ba spyi rgyud las gsungs pa bu ram dang til dang la phug rnams kyang spang*/ khams ngan na bu ram bsten na nyes pa chung bar gsung*/ dngos gzhi nyin nangs mo snga bar gnas khang phyag dar dang khrus bya/ gos gsar pa gyon/ da nangs nam langs nas sang nam langs kyi bar du smra ba bcad de ngag gi las thams cad yid kyis bya ba 'di bya rgyud kyi bsam gtan yan lag yin par gsungs/ 'don bya rnams kyang yid kyis brjod/ gzungs dngos shub bur bzla/ rab mchil ma'ang mi mid/ 'bring mchil ma mid cing chus kha skom bsal/ tha ma rgas pa dang rlung nad can dag 'o ma dang zho dang mar rnams bsres nas bskol grangs snga dro man chad bsten par bshad/ gzungs bzla ba'i skabs su glo lu ba/

sgregs/ sbrid pa/ g.yal ba/ 'og rlung sogs byung na khrus dang nye reg gam kha bshal la phreng skor de'i sngags grangs su mi brtsi bar mdo 'dzin nas bskyar te bgrang*/ rjes chog nyin kyang bza' ba ma yin pa rnams spangs la dkar gsum gyi kha zas khams bzang na cho ga grub nas bya/ sngon rjes thams cad du'ang nyin mtshan gyi bar mtshams kun tu sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi bzlas pa dang*/ phyag mchod sogs dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// dus rgyun du gzungs 'don par mos na khrus dang gtsang sbra bya/ bza' ba ma yin pa spangs la/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun du ri po ta la'i gseb na rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang rgya chen po'i nang du/ 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbus pad+ma'i gdan dang zla ba'i steng na spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyugs bdag gi cha lugs can skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing*/ dbu'i g.yas na zla tshes phyed pas brgyan pa/ tshangs pa chen po bzhin ral pa'i thor tshugs steng du bcings pa/ lha'i drang srong gi cha lugs/ ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pas snam dkris byas pa/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin zhing*/ g.yon pas pad+ma thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang dar gyi sham thabs can 'od zer brgya phrag ma lus pa 'gyed cing*/ dbu'i spyi gtsug na sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyis brgyan par bltas la/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga sngags tsam gyis 'bul/ gtor ma yod na btang*/ chos sku dang gzugs sku rjes su dran pas gzungs lan grangs ji ltar nus pa smyung gnas skabs ltar bklag mthar dge ba byang chub tu bsngos pas grub bo// 'dis kyang mtha' med 'khor bar nyam thag pa'i// lus can mtha' dag srid mtsho las bsgral te// bde ldan zhing du pad dkar 'chang ba yis// rnam grol dbugs chen dbyung ba'i rgyur gyur cig

/ces pa 'di'ang bla ma thams cad mkhyen gzigs nyid kyis dgongs pas rjes su gnang ba ltar blo gros mtha' yas kyis tswa 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
